copy.headline: WWE Survivor Series 2026 card: Complete list of matches and participants for WarGames in Houston
copy.caption:
Survivor Series takes place in Houston on Nov. 28 with three namesake matches scheduled. Survivor Series has been defined by two eras: the original event, which ran from 1987 to 2021, and the WarGames period.

This year, those eras collide at Daikin Park in Houston. WWE superstars might want to take tips from the Houston Rockets because teamwork is the name of the game.

story.title: WWE Survivor Series 2026 card: Complete list of matches and participants for WarGames in Houston
story.summary: Survivor Series takes place in Houston on Nov. 28 with three namesake matches scheduled. Survivor Series has been defined by two eras: the original event, which ran from 1987 to 2021, and the WarGames period. This year, those eras collide at Daikin Park in Houston. WWE superstars might want to take tips from the Houston Rockets because teamwork is the name of the game. Three team-based matches are set for this year's show, including two WarGames matches and a traditional five-on-five Survivor Series match. The match taking up the most time on WWE programming is the gang war between The Bloodline and 946. Roman Reigns and Royce Keys' factions will settle matters inside the massive WarGames cage.
